item.title: [IGNITE-15170] Automatic snapshot restore operation fails if node consistent ID is not defined
item.description:
If a consistent node ID is not defined in the ignite configuration, the node ID is used as a consistent ID.

In such a case a snapshot restore operation fails due to incorrect comparison of different types (UUID vs String).
